content.text:
Option 2. I'm not very sure, though. The three drawings look almost the same. What tipped it: option 2 has one column fewer. The "4A / 4D" thing sits as a short line right under the "עוקבת אחרי מדד..." text, so I saw it while reading what each fund follows. In options 1 and 3 that info is pushed to the far left edge, and honestly I'd have missed it.

**What I looked at, in order:**
- **The top of the page:** the heading "קרנות סל", "4 קרנות", then the fund names on the right. "S&P 500" jumped out because that's the one my friends at work talk about.
- **"במה הכסף מושקע":** it says "עוקבת אחרי מדד S&P 500", "עוקבת אחרי מדד ת"א-125" and so on. That's clear, and it answers "what does it follow."
- **The fee column:** "0.8% קבוע", "0.3% משתנים", "0.015% נאמן". Three numbers per fund, and I don't know which one I actually pay, or whether I add them up. I took "0.8%" as the cost of the S&P fund and "0.35%" for the TA-125 one. Both still sound like small change to me.
- **The far left column:** in option 1, "חשיפה מרבית" with "מניות עד 120%" and "מט"ח עד 120%". I don't get it. 120% of what? It's a bit scary. Option 3 shows only the מט"ח line, so less noise, but it means nothing to me either.

**What I skipped:**
- The grey line at the top, "רק הקרנות שהאתר אסף...".
- The two notes at the bottom about "לא מחלקות" and "החשיפה המרבית".
- The paper numbers (מספר נייר).
- The "בדף הקרן במאיה" link. I don't know what מאיה is.

**Words I didn't get:**
- "נאמן" and "משתנים"
- "חשיפה מרבית" and "מט"ח עד 120%"
- "פרופיל 4A/4D"
- "עסקת החלף"
- "מס גם על שינויי המטבע". That one sounds like extra tax, and it bothers me on the S&P fund.

**What bugged me:**
- Nowhere does it say in shekels what this costs me on 30,000.
- There's no single "total fee" number.
- The S&P fund has the extra tags (dollar, tax) and I can't tell if that's good or bad.
- There's no button or anything telling me what to do next. If this was a real page for me, I'd have closed it after the fees.
